Reiwand puts animated wallpapers on your desktop and uses as little as possible: if nothing changes on the screen, it does no work. This page takes you from opening the app to having a wallpaper set.

h: What you see when you open the app
x: The wallpaper you have set fills the whole window. On the left there is a menu of words: Library, Explore, Lists, Sources and Create. Further down are Settings and Account. The word of the place you are in is shown in bold. At the top right it says what the current wallpaper is, with its controls. At the bottom right, a line shows the keys that work right now. Go to Library. The covers are at the bottom; use the ← and → arrows to move through them. Press Enter, or the "Set as wallpaper" button. It is set at once. With the pointer resting on the cover of a scene you see it move, without changing your desktop. The filters at the top (All, Scenes, Images, Videos, Web, From sources and Favorites) and the search box help when you have many.

A package is a wallpaper, a preset or a set of parts that Reiwand installs and plays. Its manifest ( docs/specs/package.md ) declares its rating, languages, credits, inputs and what it needs from the engine. These pages explain what packages declare, how the app treats them, and what scenes can do on the desktop and the phone. The package manifest : what a manifest declares, languages, formatted t

The manifest of a package describes it. This page lists what a reiwand.wpak/3 manifest declares, which texts can come in several languages, and which kinds of package the format describes. docs/specs/package.md describes the whole format.

In reiwand.wpak/3 the manifest declares: Item What it says Rating For all audiences or for adults, with its reasons. Photosensitivity Whether it flashes or shows fast patterns that can trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy. Origin Whether it is an original work or one remade by hand from others, with the name of its authors. Credits and license The credits and the license of each

The title, the description, the change notes and the texts of its properties can come in several languages, with string tables. Texts can also come in one file per language ( locale/<language>.json ). Reiwand picks a language with a fallback chain: Your language. Its base language. The package's language. The scripts of a scene receive the chosen language. The six example scenes are described in E

The description and the notes allow paragraphs, lists, bold, italics and https links. The app opens a link only with a click and after you confirm it. The rest of the texts are shown as they are and cannot carry < or > .

Besides images, videos and scenes, the format describes: Kind Description Web pages ( web ) An entry page, a script that loads before its own, local storage of 5 MiB at most that is never synchronized, and up to 8 https origins it can reach if you give network permission. The window.reiwand API lets it receive settings, sound, pause and folders. Presets published separately ( preset ) They depend

The format also describes: dependencies between packages ( requires.packages ); the devices it is made for ( platforms ); the accent color it proposes to the desktop; the color around the image; spanning over all screens; the flip; the frame limit; the silent start; the single playback.

Each feature has a name in requires.features . The desktop and the phone say, for each feature, whether they: run it; play the package without it; or reject it with "needs a newer version of Reiwand" before drawing anything. In this version they reject separately published resources and AVIF images. reiwand-ctl pack check says what each platform does with a package. See Compatibility and versions

The app, the tray and the phone treat mature and photosensitive packages with care. This page explains how thumbnails are blurred, how flashing packages are confirmed, and how search filters packages by rating and facets.

The app and the tray blur the thumbnails of mature packages until you decide to show them. You can show one: in the details of the app; with a click or the keyboard on the blurred thumbnail of a screen, on the app's Settings page or in the tray; in Explore , where a click on the thumbnail is enough. The decision is stored for that package. Setting Key Effect Hide mature content library.hide_mature

Before applying a photosensitive package, the app and reiwand-ctl warn and ask for confirmation once per package. The app also allows it: from its details, with Allow this wallpaper… ; for several selected items at once, with Allow these wallpapers… . Until you allow it: the daemon does not apply it; a profile does not set it (the screen shows the reason, and the profile sets it as soon as you all

Some packages are not wallpapers on their own. An assets package offers parts for other authors, and a preset carries values for a base wallpaper. This page also explains how dependencies are installed.

Import from an assets package Shows the thumbnail of each p

A preset published separately appears in the library as a variant of its base wallpaper: the card of the base lists its presets; the card of the preset names its base; Apply (or reiwand-ctl lib apply ) shows the base with those values. Values that the installed base does not know, of another type or out of range are discarded with a notice in the log.

Installing a package from a repository also installs, from the same repository, the packages it names in requires.packages that are missing. If the base is still missing, the card offers to install it.

A package can propose an accent color, limit its frame rate, set its volume and offer a shortcut. This page explains how the desktop and the phone handle these settings, and how the card says where a package works.

The author can propose an accent color ( display.accent , a color or a color property). The desktop gives it to the Plasma wallpaper, which uses it if you choose the accent from the wallpaper. The phone gives it to the system. Without it, the dominant color of the preview is proposed. reiwand-ctl state shows it per screen.

playback also applies to scenes: frame limit, volume and silence of the author. The frames per second never exceed the minimum among: what you ask for; what the author asks for; the screen; the battery; the quality level.
Scenes with sound, videos and web pages have their own volume per screen. It starts at the author's volume (or at zero if it asks to start silent) and is multiplied by the master volume.

Scenes now describe everything an author may want to redo by hand. This page lists those features, then says which of them the desktop and the phone already draw. docs/specs/scene.md describes each field and its limits.

15 more blend modes ( linear_burn … negation ); layer tint and brightness; a transform parent without changing the draw order; tilt in depth with perspective; masks with intensity; layers that feed effects; videos as mask or texture, and playback control; sprite sheets and animated GIF or WebP; filtering, repeat and mipmaps of textures; text with line wrapping, vertical alignment, background box,

Of that list, the desktop and the phone already draw: Feature Details 2D camera Center, zoom, rotation and a noise shake that is turned off by "reduce motion" and at the lowest quality. Scene glow With tint and its HDR play. Only at the highest quality, or the next one with power. It blurs at a quarter of the size, is added to the canvas with the blend without copying it and costs nothing at zero

Both platforms draw letter spacing, and the outline, shadow and blur of text. These come from a distance field that the GPU builds once per change of the text in 8-bit textures. Every GPU can draw them, also those without 16-bit floating-point textures, and they can be scaled without redrawing the letters. They also draw text with line wrapping, number of lines with ellipsis, line spacing, vertica

Videos can go anywhere an image is accepted, with a decoder per video that pauses while nothing shows it. They support the playback playback and control from scripts with layer.video : play, pause, stop, seek, rate, volume from 0 to 1, time, duration and end notice. Note: Videos inside a scene have no sound on the phone, so the volume changes nothing there.

Both platforms now compose layers with the 32 blend modes. To the 17 from before are added linear_burn , linear_dodge , darker_color , lighter_color , vivid_light , linear_light , pin_light , hard_mix , subtract , divide , reflect , glow , phoenix , average and negation . They have published per-channel formulas that the engine, the built-in effects and those of the package share.

h: Layers and masks as effect inputs
x: A layer, even if hidden, can feed the texture of an effect: { "layer" : "<id>" } It is drawn separately and enters aligned with the screen, so that each point of the effect reads the point of the other layer that lies over it. It is only drawn again when that layer changes. The masks of effects also accept a layer or a shape, with inversion, blur and intensity, like those of layers. A pass can rea

Effect What it does tint Tints the layer with a color and a blend mode, or colors it while keeping its luminosity. blend_texture Mixes another image or a layer with a blend mode, shifted and repeated. light_shafts Draws own shafts of light, in parallel, from a point or a corner, of a color or with a gradient. It only asks for frames while its speed is not zero. docs/specs/scene.md includes an equi

The desktop and the phone also already draw: layer tint and brightness; the transform parent; masks with intensity; parallax settings (the phone also with its tilt, with the same sensors as photo parallax and only while the scene is seen); sharp filtering, repeat, mirror and mipmaps of textures (mipmaps are created once, when an image is drawn at less than three quarters of its size); sprite sheet
Scripts also: read the time of day ( engine.daytime ); use the computer's time zone in Date even if it changes, without reading any file; write dates with time.format .
Scenes animate with timelines, play sound layers and show videos. This page explains timeline events and controls, how sound is played on each platform, video clocks and HDR video.

The desktop and the phone draw the named events of timelines. Each one: fires once per pass, even if a frame skips it; starts other timelines or sounds without waking the scene early. They also draw the closing of loops, which blends the last key with the first.
Scripts can: change the speed of a timeline; stop it; read its time, its duration and whether it is still running; receive its events and its end.

Option Effect Status frames and fps Timelines measured in frames. Already works on both platforms. wrap Links the end of a loop to its start. Rejected while the engine does not draw it. "seed": null Gives a scene a new seed every time it starts. —

The desktop plays complete sound layers: MP3; several files in order or at random with pauses; long sounds up to ten minutes, read as a stream without loading them whole; sounds triggered by events; with the volume and the panning smoothed. A package can bring effects of its own, written in WGSL. The desktop and the phone draw them. This page explains what an effect can do, how Reiwand checks and compiles it, and how its cost is measured.

Each effect is a JSON descriptor and a WGSL shader with up to 24 passes. A pass can: write to the next texture or to named targets at their scale (at 8 or 16 bits per channel); copy them; swap them to alternate between two (ping-pong); accumulate with per-pass blending (replace, normal, add or multiply); deform the layer with a vertex shader over a grid of up to 64 × 64 cells; read up to 8 texture

The shader receives: the time of day and the frame time; the pointer and its previous position; the screen size; the spectrum of 16, 32 or 64 bands, mixed or per channel; the parallax; the color and opacity of the layer. It has helper functions of its own: rotation, gray, HSV and the blend modes. A mask without an image takes its color from paint . A texture can use the generic white , black , noi

The inspector of each effect use shows its rules for waking the scene: which input each parameter asks for, which it waits for and which it yields to. In the package's effects it changes them with selectors, like reiwand-ctl scene act FOLDER effect_rule .

Since the shader comes from the package, naga checks it before it reaches the driver: Rule Limit Bindings No bindings of its own; all resources bounded. Loops Integer-counter loops that advance a fixed step up to a fixed limit without overflowing. Expression depth At most 256 operations deep. Operations per pixel At most 1,048,576. Length 32,768 operations long, counting each call in full. Variabl

Before checking or compiling an effect for the first time, each program notes it as "on trial". It deletes the note when it finishes or when its first frames pass. A note left by a crashed or hung process counts as a failure, like a GPU that stops. With two failures the effect is left out. It remembers by the hash of the effect, so a new version is tried again. The desktop and the phone draw a set of built-in effects, new ones and new parameters of effects that already existed. With the default values everything looks exactly as before.

The desktop and the phone also draw: gradient blending; pointer reveal; displacement by a map or by a noise of its own; caustics, glints, fire and spin; transformation; pulse (also to the beat of a sound band); local contrast; motion trail; VHS; fluids; lens flare; electric crackle. Emitters: are placed by the editor with handles on the canvas, and turned and strengthened from the tip of their arrow; are animated with keyframes on the timeline; follow a property (the canvas shows those of the current value or those that the inspector chooses for each value, and each emitter accepts its ends written out); change

The inputs of a version 2 package come only from what it declares. This includes those of its scripts, which are no longer guessed from their text. A version 1 script that declares nothing uses sound or the pointer only if it imports audio or input from reiwand , never because those words appear in a comment.

Everything has its name in requires.features . While the engine does not draw it, the desktop and the phone reject the scene with the newer-version notice. Note: The phone does not play scene sounds or have RGB lighting or several screens, so it only omits those parts.

mesh layers deform an image with a skeleton. They are already drawn on the desktop and on the phone. This page explains drawing, clips, inverse kinematics, bone physics, depth, attachments and script control.

The GPU deforms the vertices with up to four bones each and the heaviest blend shapes. The resulting image is composed like any other layer, with its effects, masks and blend modes. Performance: A still skeleton or one that has finished does not ask for frames. The pose is computed only for visible layers and without reserving memory on each frame. At the lowest quality the mesh is drawn at half r

Clips take the animations of the file, or keys of their own in the scene's JSON: rotation, position and scale of each bone, weight of each shape and order of each part. They play looped, back and forth or once. Animation layers are mixed with weight, speed, fade in and out, additive layers and layers limited to some bones. Rules pass a bone to another parent without it jumping. Expressions group s

Inverse kinematics chains turn their bones until they reach: a point; a bone; another layer; the pointer (only with the pointer permission, which the app announces like any other use of the pointer). How they solve: Exact for two bones, whose limits can bend them to the other side. In longer chains, by rounds from the pose of their clips (which keep their curve) that never bend a joint to the othe

This also applies under the tilt of the layer and that of the groups and parents that contain it, always along the face of the layer as they turn it. Faces seen from behind are hidden if asked. Any layer is attached to a bone or a node of a mesh with attach . It follows its position, rotation and scale of the same frame. What it does not inherit from the bone it keeps taking from the camera, which brings it closer and turns it like the rest of the scene.

The desktop and the phone already draw the new particle features, the same on the GPU as on the CPU. This page covers emission, initializers, operators, child systems, trails, collisions, perspective, flocks, ropes and script control. World space: particles are born with the position, rotation and scale of their layer and then do not follow it. Up to eight control points, moved by values, the cursor, the layer or scripts. Operators have life windows. They include: oscillating position, alpha or size; limiting velocity; rotation torque and brake; braking near a point; reach and falloff of attractors; vortices with a ring; turbulence with offset and mask; keeping a distance from a point, or approaching the segment between two ( keep_distance , keep_between ); remapping applied on each step ( remap force, also with ag

Flocks ( boids ) have separation, alignment, cohesion and maximum speed, with a hash grid rebuilt on each step. Limit Value Particles on the GPU Up to 8,192 Particles on the CPU 2,000 Neighbors 32, 16 or 8, depending on the quality and the computer Particles born at the same point are separated.

Particles collide against: boxes, from inside or outside; segments; the inside of a circle; the opaque part of another layer (a 128 × 128 distance field rebuilt only when the layer changes); the opaque part of an image ( collide with mask , converted on load into a distance field of up to 16,384 cells). A response can leave the particle stuck ( stick ) or kill it, which counts as a death for child

Child systems can be static, at birth, at death or following each particle (two generations at most). Children inherit the color, size, alpha and velocity of the parent particle. The children of a system with perspective are born at its depth or where it is seen drawn. When inheriting the velocity they also take the one it carries in depth. Per-layer settings cover alpha, size, amount, speed, life

Brightness, cycles and the bounded stretch of the drawing. The draw order ( render.order ): the newest, the oldest, the biggest, the smallest or the lowest on top, in 256 steps. Ropes ( render.rope ) join the particles in the order they were born with a Catmull-Rom strip built in a compute shader. A rope has up to 4,096 segments, 1,024 and 2,048 on the more modest computers, and fewer subdivisions at low quality.

Sound links take: band ranges in 16, 32 or 64 ( audio: [0, 3] , of , reduce: mean | max ) of one channel; bounds ( bounds ) and exponent; a different smoothing when rising and falling ( smooth: { up, down } ). These also work for the cursor, properties and scripts. A scene can set with audio its attack, its decay and whether it follows the system volume ( gain: fixed ) or adjusts itself ( auto ).

Scripts control particles with particles(layer) : play , pause , stop , playing , emit(n) , point(n, [x, y]) , instance , and from(n, layer) and wall(n, layer) . from(n, layer) and wall(n, layer) make the emitter or collider n of layer type take another layer, also a copy of a template ( null goes back to that of the system).

A scene simulates at most 64 systems, counting children and layers with their own particles, within the 200,000 particles. Prewarming reaches 30 s in steps of 1/15 s. Note: When the particles move to the processor, the state of the screen says so ( "particles": "cpu" ), and the app, the tray, reiwand-ctl when showing the scene and the phone's settings warn that fewer are shown.
The desktop and the phone draw light layers, volumetric light, projected textures and lit particles. A scene without lights looks exactly as before.

Light layers ( type: light ) can be: point; spotlights, with their inner and outer cone; tubes; directional. They have color, intensity, radius and height over the canvas, and are parented, attached to bones and animated like other layers.

Lights are not drawn themselves. Image, video and text layers with lighting receive them with: their normal map; roughness (with its map); reflection of an image or of what is underneath; own light (with its map); an intensity that blends the lit with the usual. They also receive the ambient light of canvas.ambient , and that of the sky of canvas.sky according to where the normal faces. Scripts re

Light is computed in the same pass that draws the layer, with 12 lights at most (8 on phones and modest computers) and only as far as each reaches. With still lights the lit layers are drawn once and stored. A moving light only redraws the box of its radius. At the lowest quality, light is computed once at the start or when the level or size changes, and moving lights stay where they began, withou

Point lights and spotlights can light the air ( volumetric , with density, samples and shafts). It is a glow that comes out of the light up to its radius, at the place of the light among the layers: those on top cover it. The dark parts of the layers below cut the light into shafts if asked. A spotlight projects an image, a video or a layer with its effects ( texture , up to four spotlights per scene) onto the lit layers and the air. Particles take only its color. Note: A layer that receives light cannot be projected, to avoid a loop.

Particles receive the lights ( render.lit ) on both faces, up to 8, with a normal map that turns with each particle ( render.normal ). This is the same in the GPU simulation as in the processor one. Particles can refract what is behind them with a normal map ( render.refract , like drops on glass): Quality Refraction Q3 Full size Q2 Half size Q1 and Q0 None
The desktop and the phone draw 3D models ( type: model ). This page covers model files, 3D groups, materials, the 3D camera, cost limits, HDR, animation, special materials and shadows.

Models are binary glTF with: meshes and nodes; metallic-roughness materials (color, normals, metal and roughness, occlusion, own light, transparency modes and double face); PNG, JPEG or WebP textures of up to 4096 pixels (2048 on phones and modest computers).

A loose model is drawn in its own box. A group with space: "3d" gathers its models in a pass with 32-bit reversed depth and is composed like one more layer, with effects, masks and blending. The flat layers of the group stay in front unless they ask for depth_test . Then they are placed on the plane the camera faces and the nearest models cover them.

Scene materials change by name: the shader ( pbr or unlit ); the tint; the own light; the double face; the numbers. Light layers light the models (12 at most, 8 on phones), with ambient light and sky light. A panoramic image ( env ) gives the surrounding light and the reflections, without reflections at the lowest quality. See Lights .

The 3D camera ( camera3d : field of view, near and far planes, eye, center and up) serves models, 3D groups and tilted layers. Scripts change it for the next frame. The 3D camera follows paths ( camera3d.paths ) by keys with a centripetal Catmull-Rom curve: in order or at random; with a fade to black or crossfade between them; with closed loops without jumps.

A still model is drawn once and stored. A 3D group is only redrawn when something of its own changes. Each class of computer accepts 50,000, 150,000, 500,000 or 2,000,000 triangles (with the fur layers of the lowest quality). If the models draw more: with automatic quality, that computer shows the poster of the scene; with a fixed level or a chosen minimum, it plays it anyway and warns of what it

With canvas.hdr the colors brighter than white are kept in 16-bit images, and canvas.tonemap ( aces , agx or srgb_to_linear ) adjusts them to the screen in a last pass. Without tonemap , the scene looks as always.

Models are animated with the same system as meshes (see Skeleton meshes ): clips of the animations of the file or with keys of their own (x, y and z rotations and 3D displacements per bone, blend shape weights); animation layers with weight, speed, additive mode, fades and bone mask; bone physics, which freezes at the lowest quality; root motion ( root_motion ), with which an advancing clip moves

Material What it does fur Fur layers pushed along the normal, from 1 to 32 and fewer at low qualities, with length, density and combing direction. foliage Swaying with the canvas wind, measured by the red of the vertex colors. chroma A key color that becomes transparent. Package material shader fn material(s: Surface) -> Surface , validated and limited like any package effect.

Point, spot and directional lights can cast shadows ( shadows ) with maps of 2048, 1024 and 6×512 pixels, filtered with four samples. Computer Lights with shadows Desktop Two T2 class One More modest classes None A map is only redrawn when its light or what it casts changes.

Packages say which engine features they use, and each Reiwand version decides what it can play. This page explains how features are computed, what older versions see, and where the reference tables are.

reiwand-ctl pack build computes the engine features that the package uses ( requires.features ) and writes them to the manifest. If a package asks for a feature or a version that this Reiwand does not know, it says that a newer version is needed (on the desktop, with its thumbnail). The validator checks that the declared inputs include those that the scene can use with any value of its properties,

Versions published before version 2 of the manifest do not open their packages, but keep reading the repositories that have them. They only see in them those of the first version. Web pages, presets and resource packages go only in the new repository indexes, which those versions do not read, so they do not see them. Repository clients skip the versions of a package type they do not know instead o

After updating Reiwand, the library reads its packages again once. Packages that asked for a newer version start working, and the earlier ones receive their facets. On the phone, the page of a package warns of what does not work there.

The table of profiles (what the desktop and the phone do with each feature) is in docs/specs/package.md . docs/specs/scene.md ends with a guide to remake by hand a scene made with another program: where each part goes in the format and how to port HLSL and GLSL functions to WGSL.

A web package is a page (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WebAssembly, WebGL, images, fonts, sound and video inside the package itself) that is shown as wallpaper with the same transitions, fit, FPS limit and pauses as the others. It is drawn by reiwand-web , a separate process that the service starts for each page that is seen and stops as soon as no screen shows it. It needs Qt WebEngine (Qt 6.8 or later)

A wallpaper can paint the keyboard, the mouse and other RGB lights through an OpenRGB server (with its SDK protocol; the client is our own). A scene does it with an adjustment layer with rgb: true , which sends what it captures (the whole canvas or the region of its size ) reduced to 64 × 16 at most; a web page, with window.reiwand.rgb.setImage(bytes, width, height) , which returns true only when

A scene can show what is playing in a player on the computer: the title, the artist, the album, the cover, its colors, whether it is playing or paused and how far along it is. What the program does with the network and with your data. There is no telemetry, nothing connects unless you add it, and no scene sees your sound, pointer or clicks without your permission. Network and updates : private mode, checks for a new version, providers, repositories, web wallpapers, RGB lighting, models and servers. What the program connects to, and when. There is no telemetry, and private mode cuts the whole network at once.

Turn it on in Settings › Device, or with reiwand-ctl private on . It cuts the program's whole network at once. While it is on: sources and repositories are not updated; nothing is downloaded; no covers are requested from the internet; no server is contacted; the OpenRGB lights are turned off (they talk over TCP even if they are on this computer); web wallpapers only load files from this computer;

Only the AppImage and the phone app make one. The RPM and the Flatpak are updated by their package manager. The AppImage asks GitHub ( github.com ) once a day for its latest release. When it is newer and its SHA256SUMS carries the signature of the Reiwand key, it downloads and installs it. The request carries the generic User-Agent of curl and nothing of yours. It is on from the install, which say

No telemetry and no usage statistics. The service only connects to the internet for the wallpaper providers and the repositories that you add. Each repository belongs to a server, and its catalog, your downloads and, if you have an account, your session go to that server. On startup it only contacts a provider if its automatic update is due. The daily check of the repositories ( repos.auto_refresh

The service only opens network connections for the providers, repositories and servers that you add: its own network gate refuses the rest. Note: The systemd unit only limits it to local, netlink and IP sockets, not to addresses. Its logs do not include paths, file names, servers of your own or the GPU model except with RUST_LOG=debug .

Web wallpapers have no network unless they declare it and you allow it. What they see of you (time zone, language, graphics card and their stored data) is announced in the app, the tray, reiwand-ctl and the phone, and you can hide it per wallpaper. On the phone the WebView runs with its metrics and safe browsing off.

RGB lighting is off by default. When on, it only sends colors (never anything else): to the OpenRGB server of this computer, or to the address you choose with a visible notice; only from the packages you allow it for.

The depth model, the LaMa fill model and ONNX Runtime are only downloaded if you ask and accept their size, license and servers. They carry the same generic User-Agent, no Referer header and no HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects. They are verified with SHA-256. The maps are computed on the computer, in a separate process. A server only knows what you ask of it: your account and what you upload or vote on in its repositories. It does not store your library, lists, favorites or settings: there is no synchronization. Where the program keeps keys, passwords, the configuration, the library and its caches, and who can read them.

API keys and passwords are stored in the system keyring (Secret Service) and nowhere else: not in the configuration; not in the logs; not on the command line. They do not travel to another computer except in a file exported with --secrets , encrypted with a password. Providers and their keys belong to each computer.

A computer without a keyring can store all the secrets (providers, scene scripts and sessions of your accounts) in a private file (0600) that you choose knowingly. To Do Store them in a file reiwand-ctl provider store file , or the notice on the providers page Go back to the keyring reiwand-ctl provider store keyring A visible notice stays while it is that way. You can go back to the keyring witho

The configuration is written with 0600 permissions inside a 0700 folder: only your user can read it. The download cache is kept in a private folder. The fade between wallpapers works between all types: from an image, a scene or a video to another of any type, the one leaving and the one entering are mixed. A video enters or leaves through the GPU during the fade. Then it goes back to the direct path without cutting or restarting.

When adding a video, the app checks that the phone has a decoder for its video track and takes its first frame, as the desktop checks that GStreamer can open it. If it cannot, it does not add the video and counts it in the notice of files that could not be opened.

Some videos the phone can only decode with the processor: it has no hardware decoder for their format, size or speed. If the phone does decode H.264 in hardware at that size or at 1080p or 720p, the app converts the video when adding it to an H.264 copy, with Android's own encoder (Media3 Transformer, no encoders added to the APK). Convert videos this phone cannot play smoothly in Settings has three options: Option Result Convert them The copy takes the place of the original, which is deleted, and keeps its lists and its choice. Convert and keep the original The copy is added as another video. Never Nothing is converted.

With power saving the app converts nothing when adding, and says so. The page of that video says why it is worth converting it and offers Convert for this phone and Convert and keep the original . These also work with power saving, because you ask for it.

The conversion asks WorkManager to keep the app alive while it lasts (without low battery) and notes what is left in a file. If Android closes the app earlier, the conversion is resumed from scratch as soon as the app starts again or WorkManager wakes it. It is discarded if the video already changed or does not exist.

10-bit HDR videos (PQ or HLG) always come out as 8-bit H.264 with the standard range (tone mapping). Audio that the MP4 container does not support is re-encoded to AAC. Videos that the phone already decodes in hardware play as they are.

Repositories are signed catalogs of packages. This page explains how they withstand failures, how provider downloads are bounded, animated previews, and how to use a home-network repository.

Searches read all repositories and the installed packages at once, so they never mix a catalog with another list of installed ones. Two updates of the same repository from different processes never return it to an earlier state. An installation checks again, when the download ends and before moving to the library, that the repository is still there and that neither the version nor its key were rev

If the stored copy of a repository is damaged (its state.json is missing, for example), reiwand-ctl remote ls and the app show it as broken without affecting the others. Run reiwand-ctl remote refresh to download it again from its address. If the address was lost, repair it by adding it again with its URL, or remove it.

Cancelling a download stops it within a tenth of a second even if the server sends nothing (before, it waited up to 30 s), also in copies from file:// . The previews of earlier versions are downloaded only once and deleted with their repository.

A provider cuts a download as soon as it does not fit in cache_mb (by its Content-Length or on reaching that size). Its cache cleanup resolves symbolic links and never deletes outside its folder. Removing it without --purge also deletes its sync state, so when added again it syncs right away. This page explains how frames move between the GPU, streams and the video decoder without copies, the environment variables that control it, and measurements on an NVIDIA GPU.

Streams carry each frame in GPU memory (DMA-BUF) when the Vulkan driver can export it and the consumer (KPipeWire on Plasma) import it. The daemon then draws directly into the stream's buffers, without reading the frame back or copying it with the CPU, also on battery. Where the GPU cannot draw in the format the consumer asks for, such as linear images on NVIDIA GPUs, it draws into a texture of it

The daemon composes and sends only the rectangle that changed: In GPU memory, it draws into each buffer what changed since the last time it used it. In shared memory, it reads from the GPU and copies only those rows. Both kinds of buffer carry SPA_META_VideoDamage with what changed since the previous buffer, for the consumers that read it. A small clock over a 4K image thus copies about 55 KiB per

If something is missing (OpenGL, software rendering, a consumer without DMA-BUF), the stream uses shared memory without intervention. Image edits are non-destructive: they never touch the image file. This page describes the editor in the app, the reiwand-ctl edit commands, and spanning an image over several screens.

Edits are saved in <image>.reiwand.json next to the image, or in ~/.local/share/reiwand/edits/ if the folder cannot be written. The GPU applies them, and the daemon reads them again as soon as they change.

The app edits them from the card of each image ("Edit…"). The window has three parts: Part Content Left The sections, always in view, each with its icon; below them, the Operations, in order . The arrows go through the list. Middle The controls of the chosen section. Right The edited image. The sections are Crop and rotate , Screens , Light and color , Curves , Effects , Masks , Depth and Parallax

The app itself draws the image on the GPU, with the same development as the daemon and reiwand-ctl edit export . It is reduced (1024 pixels per side at most, 512 with software rendering) and drawn only when a value changes or a new depth map arrives. If it cannot draw it, a notice says why. Another notice warns if the image changed after editing it. reiwand-ctl edit and the daemon log say so too.

With a gray depth map (white near), the daemon shifts the near more than the far. It follows one of these sources: a slow orbit; the pointer; the computer's accelerometer. It moves only while the wallpaper is seen, at the pace the screen allows, with the same pauses as video. It stays still if the system asks to reduce motion. 3D parallax computed once per image. An image only moves in layers, without stretching anything. This page explains how the layers are built and filled, the commands to inspect them, and the author tools in the editor. Depth maps themselves are covered in Depth maps and parallax .

The daemon prepares a set of layers of the image once, in the background, and never per frame. It runs as a Layers job with its progress, which shows in reiwand-ctl jobs . It refines the map with a filter guided by the image itself. It looks for the depth jumps and splits the image into connected regions between them. The fine, like a lock of hair, stays with its object; small pieces join the neig

The edge of each near object takes the transparency of the image itself, without strips of the background. Behind it, the strip that the movement can uncover is marked. It is filled without copying the edge of the object, according to the fill of the edit of each image: fill Method lama (the default on the desktop) uses the LaMa model on 512 px crops at the resolution of the image simple extends t

LaMa (big-lama in ONNX, 208 MB, Apache-2.0) is not included. It is downloaded with reiwand-ctl models download lama-big-fp32 (or from the app's settings) after showing size, license and server, with the same rules as the depth model. Without it, or without ONNX Runtime, simple is used. It runs on the processor, or on CUDA if ORT_DYLIB_PATH points to an ONNX Runtime with CUDA, with minimum priority

The set is computed at the resolution the screen asks for: 1024, 1920, 2560 or 3840 px on the longer side. It is stored in the map cache ( ~/.cache/reiwand/depth/<SHA-256>-<key>.layers.png , .fields.png and .layers.json , within the same 256 MB). The key gathers the image, the model, the fill, the number of layers, the strength, the resolution and the settings of the map.

The movement is clipped per image so as never to exceed the filled strip. The enlargement is computed with the strength, the focus and the shape of the image so that the edge of the frame is never seen. When moving, the GPU draws the layers from back to front, and at rest shows the original image. A crop, rotation, straightening or flip also turns the layers. The image stays still while the layers

Each release on the Releases page always has the same file names and a SHA256SUMS to check them. SHA256SUMS is signed with cosign without a key of its own: The signature ( SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json ) carries a short-lived certificate that Sigstore issues for the CI of this repository on the main branch. It is recorded in Sigstore's public transparency log. Note: Releases published before the move t

SHA256SUMS.asc signs the same file with the Reiwand release key: Fingerprint 9C23 C7EF 7478 9850 1E4D 8EBF 0C9F 3D23 2716 55A8 Public part packaging/flatpak/repo-key.asc of the source code After importing the key, run gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.asc SHA256SUMS .

Download reiwand-x86_64.AppImage from the latest release. Run it: chmod +x reiwand-x86_64.AppImage ./reiwand-x86_64.AppImage --install Opening the file from the file manager does the same and then opens the app. The downloaded file is no longer needed afterwards. It also works on distributions with an immutable file system.

It installs everything in your home directory, without root: the version in ~/.local/lib/reiwand/<version> , with ~/.local/lib/reiwand/current pointing to it; the commands reiwand , reiwandd , reiwand-ctl , reiwand-app and reiwand-web in ~/.local/bin ; a systemd user service; D-Bus activation; the desktop app, with its launcher and icon; the wallpaper plugin and the Plasma tray icon. The app asks
--install with a newer AppImage upgrades Reiwand and restarts the service, and so does opening it. Opening an older one only opens the installed app. For automatic updates, see Updates and versions .

The install asks the session bus to re-read its services, so that the tray opens the app without logging in again. This also works with dbus-broker, which does not watch for new services. If the bus still does not know the app, the tray asks it to re-read its services and tries again. If it still does not open, it says so.
Run reiwand --uninstall . Add --purge to also delete the configuration.

The AppImage also runs its programs without installing anything: Command What it does ./reiwand-x86_64.AppImage reiwand-ctl --help Runs reiwand-ctl ./reiwand-x86_64.AppImage --version Shows the version ./reiwand-x86_64.AppImage --help Lists the rest That needs FUSE ( fusermount3 or fusermount , present on most desktops). Without it, put --appimage-extract-and-run first, as in ./reiwand-x86_64.AppI

How the AppImage updates itself, what happens with data from another version, and how version numbers are made and published.

Reiwand installed from the AppImage updates itself. A systemd user timer ( reiwand-update.timer ) looks once a day for a newer release on GitHub and installs it. It waits while the computer is on battery or on a metered connection. It shows a notification when it is done. In Plasma it asks to restart Plasma, which keeps the old tray icon and wallpaper plugin until then. It never installs an older
Command What it does reiwand --update --check Says whether there is a newer version. reiwand --update Installs it.

The install says that the daily check is on. To stop it: in the app: Settings › Advanced › Version › Details ("Install new versions by itself"); or reiwand-ctl update auto off ( on turns it on again). The choice stays across updates. Note: With private mode on there is no check at all, neither daily nor by hand ( reiwand-ctl update allowed tells why). An AppImage older than this function does not

Each version knows only the current format of each piece of data it stores: settings, image edits, permissions, accounts, library, repository records, exported files, scenes and packages. A change that breaks a format is a major version, and no program reads or converts the previous format. If a program finds data from another version it refuses to start or to open it, says so and overwrites nothi

Versions strictly follow Semantic Versioning 2.0.0. GitVersion computes them in the CI from the commits of the main branch, written with Conventional Commits: type(scope)!: description The scope and ! are optional. Commit Effect on the version fix and perf Raise the patch: 1.0.0 → 1.0.1. feat Raises the minor version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0. ! after the type or the scope, or a BREAKING CHANGE: or BREAKING-

The CI checks the subject of every commit since the last published version and the title of each pull request, also each time it is edited. While any of them does not follow that format, the main branch or the pull request fails and nothing is published. A badly written commit that is already on the branch is fixed by adding its hash to ignore.sha in GitVersion.yml together with a new commit of th

Only commits that raise the version publish a new one. When the last commit of the main branch builds and its version is greater than all those published, the CI creates v<version> on the Releases page of the repository, with: the files; an SPDX SBOM of the dependencies ( reiwand.spdx.json ); a signed SHA256SUMS ; the notes grouped into breaking changes, new features and fixes. The other branches and the pull requests carry a prerelease of the next version whose number grows with each commit ( 0.3.1-branch-name.2 , 0.4.0-feature-name.1 , 0.3.1-PullRequest12.1 ). They are not published.

You do not need a browser on the server computer: everything the administration web asks for has its terminal command, below.

A single binary in a container without a shell. It runs as root by default. With a user: line in compose.yaml it can run as another user. Everything lives in the ./data folder, mounted as /data . The backup is copying that folder (see Backups and data from another version ). It sends no telemetry and does not connect to third parties.

compose.yaml pulls ghcr.io/reiwand/reiwand-server with the tag of REIWAND_VERSION ( latest if not set). Each version publishes that image: Platform linux/amd64 , with the tags <version> and latest . Signed with cosign without a key of its own, like the files of Releases . With the BuildKit SPDX SBOMs attached (the packages of the image and of the build stage) and its provenance. With a signed SPDX

To pin a specific image: Take its digest. Check the signature and the attestation. Put the digest in place of the tag ( image: ghcr.io/reiwand/reiwand-server@sha256:<digest> ). IMAGE = ghcr.io/reiwand/reiwand-server DIGEST = $( docker buildx imagetools inspect " $IMAGE :<version>" --format '{{ .Manifest.Digest }}' ) ID = https://github.com/reiwand/reiwand/.github/workflows/ci.yml@refs/heads/master

To build the image from this repository instead of pulling it, add the build file: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.build.yaml up -d --build A server built that way identifies itself with the version of Cargo.toml and the suffix -local . The configuration goes in environment variables, in the .env next to compose.yaml . .env.sample lists them all with their default value. VARIABLE_FILE reads the value from a file, for secrets. Variable Default Use REIWAND_PUBLIC_URL required in compose Public URL of the server REIWAND_VERSION latest Tag of the image compose pulls REIWAND_BIND 127.

http:// is only valid for the server's own computer. A server on another computer needs HTTPS. There are two ways: the server's own certificate on a home network, or a reverse proxy with a domain of your own.

h: On a home network, with the server's own certificate
x: On a home network without a domain, the server can serve HTTPS itself with a certificate of its own, with the address the administrator gives by hand: REIWAND_TLS = self-signed REIWAND_LISTEN = 0.0.0.0:8443 \ REIWAND_PUBLIC_URL = https://192.168.1.10:8443 reiwand-server serve reiwand-server fingerprint # the SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate, also in the log reiwand-ctl remote add https://192

h: With a domain, behind a reverse proxy
x: With a domain of your own, any reverse proxy with TLS works: The server listens on REIWAND_BIND ( 127.0.0.1:8080 by default). The proxy terminates HTTPS and forwards the requests. REIWAND_PUBLIC_URL carries the public address with https:// .

The server takes the client address from X-Forwarded-For when the proxy runs on the same computer (also with the image of compose.yaml ). A proxy in another container or on another machine is named in REIWAND_TRUSTED_PROXIES . A computer of the home network that talks directly to the server cannot pass itself off as another address.

Withdraw this wallpaper for good asks first. Once confirmed: every version leaves the repository, its files are deleted, the devices that installed it stop showing it at their next refresh. The package id stays with the author, who can upload a newer version later. The same is available in two other places: In the app: Account , My uploads , Withdraw for good… on a row. In the terminal: reiwand-ct

Withdraw from the catalog is the hiding described below, with a reason the author sees, and Return to the catalog . Withdraw from the repository comes with a statement the author sees in Account . Every published version is revoked and its files are kept for a counter-notice, as with the same decision on a case in Moderation .
Administrators also see Delete this wallpaper . It asks first, then revokes every version, deletes its files and its votes, and keeps the id with its owner.

Moderators can hide a package without withdrawing it, with a reason that its author sees. It disappears from the catalog and the search. Whoever has it installed keeps it and receives its updates. It is done from Moderation on the web, with the API, or in the terminal with a personal token with the mod permission in REIWAND_SERVER_TOKEN : reiwand-ctl moderate --server https://wallpapers.example.or

Repositories has Delete this repository… under each repository. It asks first and says what is lost: the address stops answering, its packages, votes, members, keys and signed index are deleted. Devices that added it keep what they had installed and get nothing new from it. A repository created later with the same name has other keys, so those devices refuse it instead of taking it for the old one
Packages are signed by their authors. This page covers online author keys on a server, the key and check tools of the editor and the terminal, and Edit a copy… for making a derived package.

With repo init --online-authors , each account registers in Account the keys with which it signs its packages, without going through the root key. Each client trusts the key that signed the first version it installed of each package. It only accepts another if the previous one authorized it. This command signs that handover, which is stored in Account : reiwand-ctl pack rotate-key old.key new.pub

In the editor, the build dialog has Keys… . It: creates the author key pair in the application's key folder, with permission only for you and an optional password, never shows a secret key, says which of the two files is the secret and which the public one, asks before replacing a pair, signs the handover of an online author to another key.

h: A spot that projects an image
x: A spot with texture multiplies its color by the image, which fills the outer cone like a projector. A video keeps playing and asks for frames. { "layer": id } projects that layer as it is drawn, with its effects, even if it is hidden; the projected layer cannot receive light itself or contain or read a layer that does. Up to 4 spots in a scene project.

A model layer draws a binary glTF model ( .glb ) with metal and roughness materials. On its own, it is drawn in its own box ( size , the canvas by default) with depth and then composited like any layer, with its effects, masks, blending and transform . The materials in the file give the color, the metal, the roughness, the normal, the occlusion and the glow with their factors. A group with space: "3d" draws all its models at once with a shared depth, in a box the size of the canvas, and is composited as a single layer in the group's place. A 3D group inside another shares its depth if it is "simple" (no effects, mask, blending, opacity, color , brightness , clip , tilt , z or depth_test ). Without position3d , each light is on the plane that passes through the point the camera looks at, below the point of the box where it is drawn, brought closer to the viewer by its z . With position3d the light is at that point among the models, whatever happens with the camera: it can end up behind or beside a model. With aim3d , a spot or a directional light shines from there toward that point.

A point light, a spot or a directional light with "shadows": true casts shadows of the models onto the models whose materials receive them. A scene can have up to 2 lights with shadows. A web wallpaper is a page that Reiwand shows behind the windows. Everything it uses goes inside the package: there is no server, the network is cut off unless you declare it and the user allows it, and the page cannot open windows, dialogs or downloads. h: Changing the document at a low level
x: These four actions edit any part of the document by its path. They do not check ranges or field names: to know whether the result is valid, run reiwand-ctl pack check my-scene . The app's windows do the same with their fields.

Writes a value at a path. If objects are missing along the way, it creates them. If the path already exists, it replaces the value. How Reiwand looks and why. This page is for contributors who change the desktop app (QML), the phone app (Android, Kotlin) or the pages the server renders. The token tables are in Look of the desktop app and the way the tones are derived is in Interface palette ; this page does not repeat them. It gives the rules and says which piece to use.

The window is the wallpaper you have on. The app is a title screen: a few confident words and a shelf of large covers over the living picture. The interface is always dark (the editor alone may be light, see Workbench). Every tone has a name and comes from the wallpaper in use, except four fixed ones. There is no blur, no glass and no decorative gradient: separation is a veil in the picture's own

All three share the tone names, the two typefaces, the Phosphor icons, the 6 px radius, the 4/8/12/16 spacing rhythm, the one-lit-thing rule, the three state tones, the main button in the accent and the Frost keyboard focus ring. The Own-Tones Rule. Every tone comes from the wallpaper in use and has a name. Do not add a colour to a page, a component or a Kotlin screen. If one is needed, it is a change to reiwand-palette .
